en-US.title: SpellsCast
en-US.subtitle: Your phone becomes a wand
en-US.promoText: Turn your phone to a magic wand
en-US.description:
Turn your iPhone into a magic wand and bring spells to life on a bigger screen.

START FROM YOUR PHONE
Send a game link to your computer using Messages, email, AirDrop to a Mac, or another sharing app. Open the link on that screen, confirm, and your iPhone connects automatically. Already have a game open? Scan its QR code or enter the six-digit room code.

CAST WITH MOTION OR TOUCH
Hold the cast pad, move your phone through a rune, and release. Prefer touch controls? Draw the rune directly on the pad. Follow your score and lives on your phone and feel your casts with haptic feedback.

LEARN FOUR SPELLS
Expel rogue mages, levitate feathers, banish ghosts, and shatter serpents. Practice all four runes offline, even when you do not have another screen nearby.

PLAY TOGETHER
Connect up to two phones to the same game. Built-in guides help you set up a TV browser, connect a computer with HDMI, or mirror a Mac using AirPlay.

Connected play requires internet access and a separate computer or compatible TV browser displaying https://emirhan777.github.io/SpellsCast/. Music and sound play on that screen. TV browser and AirPlay support depend on your devices. No player account is required.
